figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. BGCs, deduced hybrid NRPS/PKS assembly-lines, and chemical structures of FK228, thailandepsins A–F, and spircuchostatins A–D. (a) A graphic comparison 
between BGCs and deduced hybrid NRPS/PKS assembly-lines of dep, tdp and spi BGCs. (b) Chemical structures of FK228, thailandepsins A–F, and spircuchosta­
tins A–D.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Optimization of recombineering efficiency of the recombineering system RecETh1h2eYI23 in B. thailandensis E264. (a) Different recombineering systems in 
B. thailandensis E264. gba, Redγβα of lambda phage. EThe_bdu8, RecET homologs and hypothetical proteins of Burkholderia sp. BDU8; ETh_tji49, RecET homologs and 
a hypothetical protein of Burkholderia sp. TJI49; ETh1h2e_yi23, RecET homologs and hypothetical proteins of Burkholderia cordobensis YI23. (b) Recombineering 
efficiency comparison using different incubation times. (c) Recombineering efficiency comparison using different induction times. H2O. (d) Recombineering effi­
ciency comparison using different electroporation buffers. H2O, sterilized double-distilled water; S, 10% sucrose (W/V); G 10% glycerol (W/V); SH, 10% sucrose + 2 
μM HEPES; GH, 10% glycerol + 2 μM HEPES. (e) Recombineering efficiency comparison using different DNA amounts. (f) Recombineering efficiency comparison 
using different length of homologous arms. Data are presented as mean values ± SD. n = 3 biologically independent samples.

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Overview of construction of the strain KOGC1. (a) Deletion of the tdp BGC by the RecETh1h2eYI23 recombineering system. (b) Replacement of pheS-tetR DNA

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Design and construction of the BGC tdp and hybrid BGCs tdp-dep and R-tdp-dep. (a) Construction of the p15A-cm-tdp plasmid by ExoCET direct cloning. (b) 
Construction of the plasmid p15A-kan-oriT-phiC31-R-tdp. (c) Construction of the plasmid p15A-kan-oriT-phiC31-R-tdp-dep. (d) Construction of the plasmid p15A- 
kan-oriT-phiC31–tdp-dep.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Engineering scheme of the hybrid R-tdp-dep 
BGC via pathway-level modification. (a) Direct clon­
ing and modification of the tdp BGC, and construction 
of the hybrid R-tdp-dep BGC. (b) HPLC-MS analysis of 
the extracts of the fermentation broth of the strain 
KOGC1 harboring different BGCs: i, KOGC1; ii, EIC of 
thailandepsin A isolated from the strain KOGC1 
harboring R-tdp BGC; iii, EIC of FK228 isolated from 
the strain KOGC1 harboring R-tdp-dep BGC; iv EIC of 
FK228 B (1) isolated from the strain KOGC1 
harboring R-tdp-dep BGC. (c) The structural change 
from thailandepsin A to FK228 and FK228 B (1).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 6. Engineering scheme of domain unit replace­
ment in R-tdp-dep BGC. (a) Construction of R-tdp-dep- 
M6(AT)tdp, R-tdp-dep-M4(AT)M5(C)tdp, and R-tdp- 
dep-M4(ATE)M5(C)spi BGCs via module replacement. 
(b) HPLC-MS analyses of metabolites from the strain 
KOGC1 harboring R-tdp-dep-M4(ATE)M5(C)spi BGC. i, 
EIC of FK228 C (2); ii, EIC of FK228 D (3); iii, EIC of 
FK228 E (4); iv, EIC of FK228 F (5); v, EIC of FK228 G 
(6); vi, EIC of FK228 H (7). (c) The structural change 
from FK228 to FK228 C– H (2–7).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 7
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 7. Engineering scheme of domain unit replace­
ment in R-tdp BGC. (a) Construction of R-tdp-M4 
(ATE)M5(C)dep and R-tdp-M4(ATE)M5(C)spi BGCs 
via module replacement. (b) HPLC-MS analyses of 
metabolites from different BGCs in KOGC1. i, R-tdp 
BGC in KOGC1; ii, EIC of spiruchostatin E from R-tdp- 
M4(ATE)M5(C)dep BGC in KOGC1; iii, EIC of spir­
uchostatin E from R-tdp-M4(ATE)M5(C)spi BGC in the 
strain KOGC1. (c) The structural change from thai­
landepsin A to be spiruchostatin E (8).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 8
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 8. The titers of FK228, FK228 C (2), FK228 D (3) and spiruchostatin E 
(8) in the strain KOGC1. Data are presented as mean values ± SD. n = 3 
biologically independent samples. a. The titer of FK228 from the strain KOGC1 
harboring tdp-dep BGC. b. The titer of FK228 from the strain harboring R-tdp-
